<translated_code>
import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    R, C = map(int, input_data[0].split())
    p = input_data[1].strip()
    
    # Initialize Comb array
    Comb = [[0] * 62 for _ in range(62)]
    for i in range(62):
        Comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            Comb[i][j] = Comb[i-1][j-1] + Comb[i-1][j]
    
    n = R + C
    TT = Comb[n*2][R*2]
    
    # Initialize A and B arrays
    A = [[0] * 32 for _ in range(32)]
    B = [[0] * 32 for _ in range(32)]
    
    for i in range(32):
        for j in range(32):
            if i:
                A[i][j] = Comb[i-1][R-1] * (Comb[n*2-i][R] - Comb[j][R])
            if j:
                B[i][j] = Comb[j-1][R-1] * (Comb[n*2-j][R] - Comb[i][R])
    
    # Initialize CC array
    CC = [[0] * 32 for _ in range(32)]
    CC[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(n + 1):
            if i != n and p[i+j] != 'B':
                CC[i+1][j] += CC[i][j]
            if j != n and p[i+j] != 'A':
                CC[i][j+1] += CC[i][j]
    
    # Initialize P and Q arrays
    P = [[[] for _ in range(2)] for _ in range(32)]
    Q = [[[] for _ in range(2)] for _ in range(32)]
    
    def Put(x, y, g, c1, c2, ck):
        if x + y == R + n:
            P[x][ck].append((g, c1))
            if c2:
                Q[x][ck].append((g, c2))
            return
        # First recursive call
        Put(x+1, y, g + (0 if ck else A[x+1][y]), c1, (c2 if p[x+y] != 'B' else 0), ck)
        # Second recursive call
        Put(x, y+1, g + (c2 if ck else 0), c1, (c2 if p[x+y] != 'A' else 0), ck)
    
    for i in range(R, n + 1):
        if p[i + R - 1] != 'B':
            Put(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], CC[R-1][i], 0)
        if p[i + R - 1] != 'A':
            Put(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], CC[i][R-1], 1)
    
    def Make(vec):
        if not vec:
            return
        vec.sort()
        cnt = 0
        s = 0
        for i in range(len(vec)):
            s += vec[i][1]
            if i == len(vec) - 1 or vec[i][0] != vec[i+1][0]:
                vec[cnt] = (vec[i][0], s)
                cnt += 1
                s = 0
        del vec[cnt:]
    
    for i in range(R, n + 1):
        for j in range(2):
            Make(P[i][j])
            Make(Q[i][j])
    
    MM = TT + 1
    Res = 0
    
    def Calc1(x, y, g, ck):
        nonlocal MM
        if x + y == R + n:
            if not P[x][ck]:
                return
            target = (TT + 1) // 2 - g
            t = bisect_left(P[x][ck], (target, 0))
            if t < len(P[x][ck]) and P[x][ck][t][1] > 0:
                tp = abs((P[x][ck][t][0] + g) * 2 - TT)
                if tp < MM:
                    MM = tp
            if t > 0 and P[x][ck][t-1][1] > 0:
                tp = abs((P[x][ck][t-1][0] + g) * 2 - TT)
                if tp < MM:
                    MM = tp
            return
        Calc1(x-1, y, g + (0 if ck else A[x][y]), ck)
        Calc1(x, y-1, g + (B[x][y] if ck else 0), ck)
    
    def Calc2(x, y, g, ck):
        nonlocal Res
        if x + y == R + n:
            target = (TT + 1) // 2 - g
            t = bisect_left(Q[x][ck], (target, 0))
            if t < len(Q[x][ck]) and Q[x][ck][t][1] > 0:
                tp = abs((Q[x][ck][t][0] + g) * 2 - TT)
                if tp == MM:
                    Res += Q[x][ck][t][1]
            if t > 0 and Q[x][ck][t-1][1] > 0:
                tp = abs((Q[x][ck][t-1][0] + g) * 2 - TT)
                if tp == MM:
                    Res += Q[x][ck][t-1][1]
            return
        if p[x+y-1] != 'B':
            Calc2(x-1, y, g + (0 if ck else A[x][y]), ck)
        if p[x+y-1] != 'A':
            Calc2(x, y-1, g + (B[x][y] if ck else 0), ck)
    
    Calc1(n, n, 0, 0)
    Calc1(n, n, 0, 1)
    Calc2(n, n, 0, 0)
    Calc2(n, n, 0, 1)
    
    print(Res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
